title: Denison Mines
summary: Canadian uranium developer with the Wheeler River project.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Denison Mines is developing the Wheeler River uranium project in Saskatchewan and holds exploration and processing interests. Its Phoenix deposit is designed as an in-situ recovery operation, which could lower capital cost. Permitting and uranium prices determine the timeline.

Technology Exposure

  • Uranium development
  • In-situ recovery project
  • Exploration interests

What To Watch

  • Permitting and construction
  • Uranium prices
  • Project economics

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
